inference.scope: Matched-work/window activity targeting on observed reference tasks, fresh search seeds.
inference.primary_endpoint: Proposal-counted best-so-far loss AUC, lower is better.
inference.unit: Ten seed units; two target differences averaged within each seed.
inference.multiplicity: Joint Holm correction over eight method/baseline/design tests.
inference.claim_limit: Nonsignificance is not equivalence; target-profile generalization and gate-power prediction are not tested.
